Preeclampsia.pdf:
Bekas Pesakit Preeclampsia
1. Boleh kongsikan bagaimana pengalaman awal kehamilan anda sebelum anda mula
menyedari ada perubahan atau rasa tidak sedap badan?
Could you share what your early pregnancy experience was like before you began to
notice changes or felt something was amiss?
2. Apakah simptom atau isyarat awal—seperti bengkak pada kaki/muka, sakit kepala teruk,
atau pandangan kabur—yang mula-mula anda rasakan tetapi mungkin disangka
sebagai perubahan biasa kehamilan?
What early symptoms or warning signs—such as swelling in the feet/face, severe
headaches, or blurred vision—did you first experience that you might have initially
brushed off as normal pregnancy changes?
3. Apakah detik atau situasi yang akhirnya membuatkan anda memutuskan untuk terus
bergegas ke hospital untuk pemeriksaan?
What was the exact moment or incident that finally made you decide to rush to the
hospital for a check-up?
4. Boleh ceritakan perasaan anda sewaktu doktor mengesahkan anda mengalami
preeclampsia dan menerangkan risiko bahayanya kepada anda dan bayi?
Could you describe your emotions when the doctor confirmed you had preeclampsia and
explained the risks to both you and your baby?
5. Bagaimana anda dan pasangan mengendalikan keadaan cemas sewaktu doktor perlu
membuat keputusan untuk proses kelahiran segera demi menyelamatkan nyawa anda
berdua?
How did you and your partner handle the critical situation when doctors had to make the
decision for an immediate delivery to save both your lives?
6. Apakah cabaran terbesar dari sudut emosi dan fizikal sewaktu proses pemulihan
selepas melahirkan, terutamanya jika bayi anda perlu dipantau di wad NICU?
What was the biggest emotional and physical challenge during your postpartum
recovery, especially if your baby needed monitoring in the NICU?
7. Sejauh mana pengalaman ini mengajar anda tentang pentingnya untuk seorang wanita
mendengar dan peka terhadap setiap perubahan kecil pada tubuh badan sendiri
(listening to your body)?
How much did this experience teach you about the importance of a woman listening to
her own body and being sensitive to every small change?
8. Bagaimanakah sokongan dan keberadaan suami serta ahli keluarga menjadi kekuatan
utama anda sewaktu melalui fasa sukar ini?
How crucial was the support and presence of your husband and family as your main
source of strength through this difficult phase?
9. Mengapa penting bagi wanita luar sana untuk menggugurkan persepsi bahawa simptom
seperti bengkak air atau pening kepala semasa hamil itu perkara "biasa"?
Why is it important for women out there to debunk the misconception that symptoms like
water retention or dizziness during pregnancy are always "normal"?
10. Apakah mesej, dorongan, dan peringatan paling utama yang mahu anda sampaikan
kepada bakal-bakal ibu di luar sana mengenai kesedaran preeclampsia?

What key message, encouragement, and advice would you like to pass on to expecting
mothers regarding preeclampsia awareness?
Suami / Ahli Keluarga
1. Boleh kongsikan pengalaman anda sewaktu mula-mula melihat perubahan kesihatan
isteri dan detik cemas apabila dia dimasukkan ke hospital?
Could you share your experience when you first noticed your wife’s health changing and
the tense moment when she was admitted to the hospital?
2. Sebagai seorang suami/pasangan, bagaimana anda menguruskan emosi sendiri
sewaktu perlu kekal tenang demi memberi kekuatan kepada isteri?
As a husband/partner, how did you manage your own emotions while staying calm to
provide strength for your wife?
3. Apakah peringatan terbesar yang anda sekeluarga pelajari tentang kesihatan ibu hamil
selepas melalui ujian preeclampsia ini?
What was the biggest lesson your family learned regarding pregnant mothers' health
after going through this preeclampsia trial?
4. Apakah nasihat anda kepada para suami di luar sana dalam memainkan peranan peka
dan prihatin terhadap sebarang perubahan kesihatan isteri sewaktu hamil?
What is your advice to husbands out there on being proactive and sensitive to any
changes in their wife’s health during pregnancy?
WCC INTERVIEW QUESTIONS.pdf:
Interview Questions for Women Center for Change Penang.
1. Tahniah atas pelantikan anda sebagai pengarah baharu di WCC. Boleh kongsikan latar
belakang anda serta azam utama yang mahu anda capai sepanjang memimpin WCC?
Congratulations on your appointment as the new Director at WCC. Could you share your
background and your vision for leading WCC moving forward?
2. Bagi mereka yang belum mengenali WCC, boleh jelaskan secara ringkas peranan
utama dan perjalanan WCC dalam membendung keganasan terhadap wanita dan
kanak-kanak di Penang?
For those unfamiliar with WCC, could you briefly explain WCC’s primary role and its
journey in combating violence against women and children in Penang?
3. Apakah langkah perkhidmatan serta sokongan segera—seperti kaunseling,
perlindungan, dan bantuan perundangan—yang disediakan di WCC untuk membantu
mangsa keganasan rumah tangga dan serangan seksual?
What immediate support services—such as counselling, shelter, and legal
assistance—are provided at WCC to help victims of domestic violence and sexual
assault?
4. Dari sudut pencegahan awal (prevention measures), apakah program kesedaran atau
pendidikan yang dijalankan di sekolah dan komuniti untuk mengelakkan wanita dan
kanak-kanak daripada menjadi mangsa penderaan?
In terms of prevention measures, what awareness or educational programs are
conducted in schools and communities to protect women and children from abuse?
5. Bagaimanakah penglibatan dan kerjasama daripada pelbagai pihak—seperti badan
kerajaan, pihak polis, hospital, dan sukarelawan—membantu mengukuhkan lagi impak
kerja-kerja kebajikan WCC?
How does collaboration with various stakeholders—such as government bodies, the
police, hospitals, and volunteers—strengthen the impact of WCC's work?

6. Apakah pesanan dan dorongan utama anda kepada mana-mana wanita atau mangsa di
luar sana yang mungkin sedang takut atau buntu untuk tampil mendapatkan bantuan di
WCC?
What key message and encouragement would you give to any woman or victim out there
who may be afraid or hesitant to step forward and seek help from WCC?
7. Sebagai sebuah NGO, apakah cabaran terbesar yang dihadapi oleh WCC untuk kekal
beroperasi (stay afloat), dan apakah kaedah serta strategi kewangan yang digunakan?
As an NGO, what is the biggest challenge WCC faces to stay afloat financially, and what
methods or funding strategies?
Eg: Simple answer about Value Shop
8. Boleh kongsikan konsep di sebalik penubuhan WCC Value Shop di Island 88 (Tanjong
Tokong), dan bagaimana perniagaan barang terpakai (thrift store) ini membantu
menyokong kelangsungan dana WCC?
Could you share the concept behind the establishment of the WCC Value Shop at Island
88, and how this thrift store model helps fund and sustain WCC’s operations?
9. Apakah jenis barangan atau sumbangan daripada masyarakat yang diterima di Value
Shop ini, dan bagaimana penglibatan para sukarelawan membantu melancarkan
operasinya harian?
What types of items or community donations are accepted at the Value Shop, and how
do volunteers help keep its daily operations running?
10. Selain mengumpul dana untuk mangsa keganasan, bagaimana WCC Value Shop ini
turut mempromosikan gaya hidup mesra alam dan membina kesedaran awam dalam
kalangan komuniti tempatan?
Besides fundraising for victims of violence, how does the WCC Value Shop promote an
eco-friendly lifestyle and build public awareness within the local community?
Interview Questions for Katherine Joan Chua
1. Boleh kongsikan inspirasi di sebalik penubuhan Tropical Spice Garden di Teluk Bahang
dan bagaimana minat anda terhadap alam semula jadi bermula?
Could you share the inspiration behind establishing Tropical Spice Garden in Teluk
Bahang and how your passion for nature began?
2. Sebagai sebuah santuari rempah-ratus tempatan, apakah antara spesies tumbuhan
atau rempah paling unik dan berharga yang terdapat di dalam taman ini?
As a local spice sanctuary, what are some of the most unique and valuable plant or spice
species found inside this garden?
3. Boleh ceritakan tentang program kelas memasak (Tropical Spice Garden Cooking
School)—apa yang membuatkan pengalaman memasak di tengah-tengah rimba ini
begitu istimewa untuk pelawat?
Could you tell us about the Tropical Spice Garden Cooking School—what makes
cooking in the middle of a lush rainforest so special for visitors?
4. Bagaimana Tropical Spice Garden menghubungkan aspek alam semula jadi, warisan
kulinari tempatan, dan gaya hidup sihat (wellness) dalam satu destinasi?
How does Tropical Spice Garden connect nature, local culinary heritage, and a healthy
lifestyle within one single destination?
5. Apakah cabaran terbesar yang pernah anda hadapi dalam mengendalikan dan
memulihara sebuah taman tropika semulajadi agar ia kekal subur dan selamat untuk
pelawat?
What is the biggest challenge you've faced in maintaining and preserving a natural
tropical garden to keep it thriving and safe for visitors?

6. Sewaktu menghadapi fasa mencabar seperti pandemik sebelum ini, bagaimana komuniti
dan penyokong Spice Fam menjadi pendorong utama untuk taman ini kekal bertahan?
During challenging times like the pandemic, how did the community and 'Spice Fam'
supporters play a vital role in keeping the garden open?
7. Apakah aktiviti interaktif lain yang disediakan di sini selain daripada jelajah taman dan
kelas memasak—seperti bengkel kraf atau aktiviti riadah keluarga?
What other interactive activities are offered here besides garden tours and cooking
classes—such as craft workshops or family recreation?
8. Dari sudut pendidikan, bagaimana taman ini membantu pelawat tempatan dan
antarabangsa mengenali asal-usul rempah ratus yang digunakan dalam masakan
seharian mereka?
From an educational standpoint, how does this garden help local and international
visitors discover the roots of spices used in their daily meals?
9. Apakah detik atau maklum balas paling menyentuh hati daripada pelawat yang pernah
merasai ketenangan jiwa sewaktu berada di taman ini?
What is the most touching moment or feedback you have received from visitors who
experienced peace and healing while spending time in the garden?
10. Apakah mesej utama dan harapan anda untuk setiap pengunjung yang melangkah
masuk ke Tropical Spice Garden ini?
What is your main message and hope for every visitor who steps into Tropical Spice
Garden?
